nodes.description: Address.isContract(address) library function that checks extcodehash to determine whether an address is a contract
Address.sendValue(address payable,uint256) sends ETH with a low-level call forwarding all available gas
Proxy fallback() external payable that forwards execution to _fallback()
Abstract Proxy._implementation() virtual view returning the implementation address
Proxy._delegate(address) performs calldatacopy/delegatecall/returndatacopy and bubbles return data
Proxy._willFallback() virtual hook executed at the start of the fallback path
Proxy._fallback() internal entry point that runs _willFallback() and delegates to the implementation
BaseUpgradeabilityProxy._implementation() reads the implementation address from IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT via sload
BaseUpgradeabilityProxy._upgradeTo(address) sets the new implementation and emits Upgraded
BaseUpgradeabilityProxy._setImplementation(address) validates the address and writes it to IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT with sstore
Public payable initialize(address _logic, bytes _data) that sets the implementation once and delegatecalls init data
bytes32 internal constant IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT holding the EIP-1967 implementation storage slot
delegatecall(gas(), implementation, 0, calldatasize(), 0, 0) inside Proxy._delegate forwards full control to an untrusted implementation
inline assembly extcodehash(account) used by Address.isContract
recipient.call{value: amount}('') low-level value transfer with all gas forwarded
_logic.delegatecall(_data) inside initialize executes arbitrary attacker-supplied calldata on the proxy
inline assembly sstore(slot, newImplementation) writes the implementation pointer directly to storage
inline assembly sload(slot) reads the raw implementation pointer from storage

edges.reason: fallback() forwards all calls to the internal _fallback() routine
_fallback() executes the _willFallback() hook first
_fallback() requests the implementation address from _implementation()
_fallback() reaches the delegatecall, giving external implementation code control before the call returns
_implementation() obtains its value through the sload unsafe operation
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is used as the key for the sload read
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is used as the key for the sstore write
the implementation address returned by _implementation() becomes the delegatecall target
the implementation parameter flows into the delegatecall target slot
delegated code can call back into the proxy fallback, re-entering _fallback/_delegate
initialize calls _implementation() to require the slot is still empty
initialize calls _setImplementation(_logic) to store the initial logic address
initialize performs a delegatecall on attacker-supplied _data, allowing reentrant calls back into the proxy
public initialize relies on an unset IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT as its only guard, so it is front-runnable and lacks access control
the _logic parameter is the target of the initialize delegatecall
the _data parameter is the calldata of the initialize delegatecall
the delegatecall return flag is captured in the success local
_logic is forwarded into _setImplementation
_upgradeTo delegates the storage write to _setImplementation
newImplementation from _upgradeTo flows into _setImplementation
newImplementation is the value written by the sstore unsafe operation
_setImplementation requires Address.isContract(newImplementation) before writing
the implementation address is only validated by the extcodehash check, which can be bypassed or front-run
isContract performs the extcodehash unsafe operation
the account parameter is the operand of extcodehash
the extcodehash result is stored in the codehash local
accountHash is the reference hash compared inside isContract
codehash is compared against accountHash and 0x0 in the isContract return expression
sendValue executes the low-level value call
the recipient parameter is the target of the low-level call
the amount parameter is the value attached to the low-level call
the low-level call result is captured in the success local

newImplementation is the only argument of the _setImplementation routine
the _logic parameter is only used inside the initialize initializer
_data exists only as the calldata of the initialize delegatecall
codehash is a temporary holding the extcodehash result used by isContract
accountHash is a constant comparison value local to isContract
the success flag exists only to validate the low-level call result
